basic_details.job_title: Punjabi University Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 13 Lecturer, TGT and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Punjabi University, Patiala has invited applications for 13 posts in 11 roles under Advt No. 2843/D.P.R. The posts include Lecturer (English), Lecturer (Commerce), Lecturer (Punjabi), Lecturer (Physics) and 7 more. Applications are to be sent offline and must reach the organisation by 26 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand Draft in favour of Registrar, Punjabi University, Patiala.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 37 years (General) (as on 1 January of the year of the advertisement)

qualification.education_qualification: Lecturer Cadre: Master's degree in the subject with at least 55% marks plus B.Ed. with the subject as a teaching subject. TGT: graduation with at least 55% marks in the subject plus B.Ed. and PSTET Paper-II. ETT: graduation with at least 55% marks, two-year ETT/D.El.Ed. and PSTET Paper-I. Matric with Punjabi is required.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: M.A. English with at least 55% marks; B.Ed. with English as a teaching subject; English as an elective subject for three years in graduation. Age limit: Maximum 37 years (General). Pay: 35400-112400 (Level-6). Qualification required: M.Com / Chartered Accountant / I.C.W.A. with at least 55% marks (or equivalent with an equivalence certificate); and B.Ed. Age limit: Maximum 37 years (General). Pay: 35400-112400 (Level-6). Qualification required: M.A. Punjabi with at least 55% marks; B.Ed. with Punjabi as a teaching subject; Punjabi as an elective subject for three years in graduation. Age limit: Maximum 37 years (General). Pay: 35400-112400 (Level-6). Qualification required: M.Sc. Physics, Applied Physics, Nuclear Physics or Electronics Physics with at least 55% mark

salary_details.pay_scale: Lecturer Cadre and TGT: Rs 35400-112400 (Level-6); ETT: Rs 29200-92300 (Level-5)

exam_pattern.details: 50% relaxation in qualifying marks only for SC, ST, Other Backward Classes, P.Sh. and PwD as listed in the rules

how_to_apply: Obtain the prescribed form by hand for Rs 100/- from the in-charge of the University Enquiry and Information Centre at the University main gate.
Or obtain it by post by sending a demand draft for the form price in favour of Registrar, Punjabi University, Patiala with a 25x10 cm envelope bearing Rs 65/- postage stamps and the post name.
Or download the form from punjabiuniversity.ac.in and send it with a demand draft of Rs 100 as its price.
Submit a separate application with a separate fee for each post/subject.
Send two self-addressed 9"x4" envelopes, each with Rs 65 postage stamps, with the form.
Applications must reach the office of the Deputy Registrar (Establishment) by 26.11.2026.
important_instructions: Separate application and separate fee for each post/subject Fee is not refundable and not adjustable against any other recruitment Incomplete and late-received applications will be rejected Employed candidates apply through proper channel; an advance copy with documents may be sent directly University may fill or not fill posts; number of posts may be increased

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Punjabi University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Punjabi University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 13 vacancies: 2 Lecturer (English), 2 Lecturer (Commerce), 1 Lecturer (Punjabi), 1 Lecturer (Physics), 1 Lecturer (Biology), 1 Lecturer (History) and 5 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Punjabi University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (University Enquiry and Information Centre at the University main gate, by post, or download from punjabiuniversity.ac.in) and send it to Office of the Deputy Registrar (Establishment), Punjabi University, Patiala, by by post or in person, to reach by 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General and all other categories (including BC, EWS, sportspersons, dependents of freedom fighters and of ex-servicemen): Rs. 2000. Scheduled Castes / Scheduled Tribes of Punjab: Rs. 1000. Ex-servicemen of Punjab (self): Nil.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 37 years (General) (as on 1 January of the year of the advertisement). Relaxation: SC and BC of Punjab 42 years, Widows, divorcees and certain other categories of women of Punjab 42 years, Employees of Punjab Government, other states or Government of India 45 years, Persons with benchmark disabilities of Punjab 47 years, Ex-servicemen of Punjab Armed forces service deducted from actual age; remainder not more than 3 years above the upper limit (Punjab Recruitment of Ex-Servicemen Rules, 1982).

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 35400-112400 (Level-6) for Lecturer (English), 35400-112400 (Level-6) for Lecturer (Commerce), 35400-112400 (Level-6) for Lecturer (Punjabi), 35400-112400 (Level-6) for Lecturer (Physics), 35400-112400 (Level-6) for Lecturer (Biology).

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Lecturer Cadre: Master's degree in the subject with at least 55% marks plus B.Ed. with the subject as a teaching subject. TGT: graduation with at least 55% marks in the subject plus B.Ed. and PSTET Paper-II. ETT: graduation with at least 55% marks, two-year ETT/D.El.Ed. and PSTET Paper-I. Matric with Punjabi is required. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Punjabi passed in Matric or equivalent examination as per University rules. Reservation is only for residents of Punjab. EWS certificate issued in 2026-27 on the basis of income of financial year 2025-26. Qualification results declared after the last date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: For ETT: candidates with 10+2 and ETT/D.El.Ed. without graduation, as this route closed on 30.09.2025. For ETT: B.Ed. is not accepted in place of ETT/D.El.Ed.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Written competitive examination / written test. Final selection on the merit of the written examination. Lecturer Cadre: written competitive examination only, merit on that examination, no interview or oral test (Scheme Part 6). TGT: written competitive examination, final selection on its merit, no oral test or interview (Rule 6(4)); Punjabi Proficiency Test (Group C) must be passed.
